claims: National Doctor's Day is celebrated annually on March 30th in the United States.
National Doctor's Day was first observed in 1933 in Winder, Georgia.
The first Doctors' Day was held on March 30, 1933, in Georgia.
The first Doctors' Day was initiated by Eudora Brown Almond, wife of Dr. Charles B. Almond.
In 1990, the U.S. Congress officially designated March 30th as National Doctors' Day.
President George H.W. Bush signed the designation of March 30th as National Doctors' Day into law.
The purpose of National Doctor's Day is to express gratitude to physicians for their care, commitment, and service to the community.
